originality.rationale: The original 2021 preprint and 2022 journal text define the exact two-discontinuity QSO and give case-dependent invariant/trapping regions and periodic-point results; their inspected theorems do not establish two simultaneously full expanding five-iterate branches or a positive-entropy invariant Cantor subsystem. A closely matched indexed result bounds periodic points for each prescribed admissible branch itinerary, without proving the existence of a full shift. Other returned horseshoes concern distinct affine/tent or boundary-Hopf models, not the same nonlinear map. Actual semantic and alias searches found no covering theorem, with residual priority risk acknowledged.
residual_risks: Other uninspected publications or unpublished notebooks might already give equivalent two-branch horseshoes for this exact map.

value.rationale: In a specifically motivated two-species, variable-heredity quadratic stochastic model, source trapping theorems do not explain symbolic complexity inside the trapping band. Exact construction of two compatible full expanding returns proves coexistence of arbitrary binary histories and positive entropy, a qualitative structural phenomenon rather than a routine new parameter value. The model uses canonical extreme heredity coefficients, and the phenomenon persists for an admissible open coefficient neighborhood with arbitrary third-region inheritance parameter.
